mods.name: typecheck-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast when .ts or .tsx files were edited and no type check (tsc, vue-tsc, a typecheck script or a build) ran since the last edit.

mods.name: lockfile-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast when dependencies in package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml or go.mod changed and neither the matching lockfile was edited nor an install command ran.

mods.name: big-diff-nudge
mods.description: Suggests splitting the change once your edits added or removed more than 500 lines since the last git commit. A successful commit resets the count.

mods.name: migration-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast when a schema file changed (schema.prisma, models.py, SQL under schema/, a drizzle schema) and no migration file was created this session.

mods.name: env-example-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast when edits added a reference to an environment variable (process.env, os.environ, os.getenv, Deno.env) that .env.example does not list. Reads only the names in .env.example, never .env.

mods.name: quality-pack
mods.description: Three quiet nudges in one mod: type check after TypeScript edits, lockfile after dependency edits, and a split suggestion past 500 changed lines.
